years.label: Freshman
years.summary: Explore campus, build foundations, and learn what resources exist.

steps.title: Visit the Career Center
steps.detail: Introduce yourself to career services — they help all years, not just seniors.

steps.title: Join a club related to your field
steps.detail: Employers notice early involvement — check MU Engage for student orgs.

steps.title: Create a draft Handshake profile
steps.detail: Even as a freshman, a basic profile helps you discover events and employers on campus.

years.label: Sophomore
years.summary: Start building experience and relationships that lead to internships.

steps.title: Complete your Handshake profile + resume
steps.detail: Upload a resume and set job interests so employers can find you.

steps.title: Attend a career fair or employer info session
steps.detail: RSVP on Handshake — even listening sessions teach you what companies want.

steps.title: Browse alumni mentors in your field
steps.detail: Mizzou Mentoring lets you choose someone aligned with your goals — start with one conversation.

steps.title: Use Tiger Guide mentor question builder
steps.detail: Prepare 5 thoughtful questions before your first mentor chat.

years.label: Junior
years.summary: Apply for internships and deepen your professional network.

steps.title: Apply to internships on Handshake
steps.detail: Filter by your major and target location — apply early in fall and spring cycles.

steps.title: Schedule a mentor conversation
steps.detail: Ask about day-to-day work, skills that matter, and how they got their first role.

steps.title: Practice interviews
steps.detail: Use Big Interview or book a mock session through the Career Center.

steps.title: Book a career advisor meeting
steps.detail: Get feedback on applications, LinkedIn, and your target industry.

years.label: Senior
years.summary: Convert experience into full-time roles or grad school plans.

steps.title: Target full-time roles on Handshake
steps.detail: Set alerts for new postings in your field and apply with a tailored resume.

steps.title: Leverage alumni mentors for referrals and advice
steps.detail: Ask mentors about company culture and how to stand out in final-round interviews.

steps.title: Confirm graduation requirements in Stellic
steps.detail: Make sure your final-semester plan matches degree audit requirements.

steps.title: Explore grad school if that's your goal
steps.detail: Meet with advisors about timelines, GRE requirements, and recommendation letters.
